page.overview:
Who is Baby Teeth Finns?

The Baby Teeth Finns were creatures created by Gumbald using Finn's baby teeth, which were sold to him by BMO in "Always BMO Closing". After breaking into the Tree House, some began chewing on the furniture, while others attempted to crawl into the mouths of Finn and Jake, but were ultimately killed when the two brothers smashed them all to dust with a pair of sledgehammers provided by BMO and the Ice King.

As their name implies, these creatures are Finn's baby teeth, enlarged and given humanoid forms, mobility, and (seemingly limited) sentience by Gumbald. They ostensibly resemble Finn in his infancy, except for their white, shiny, enamel-like complexions, and the presence of a single, pronounced tooth at the same spot in their mouths.
